function: Unsupervised DNN maps the channel matrix and target angles to an ISAC precoder, tunable between communication sum rate and sensing CRLB through weight rho (pp. 5-6)
system: Sub-6 GHz (5 GHz) TDD OFDM cell; BS with M=10 or 20 transmit ULA antennas and R=10 radar receive antennas, K=10 UEs, T=2 targets; no RIS (pp. 3-4, 8)
method: DNN (4 hidden layers, 128 nodes each, SiLU), unsupervised training on a sum-rate, CRLB, fairness and power-penalty loss; one DNN per rho; post-training quantization and pruning (pp. 6-8)
data_channel: Custom Python simulation: Rician fading with Rayleigh NLOS part; path loss (exponent 2.9) from cited urban macrocell measurements; 10^6 training, 10^5 test instances (pp. 3-4, 7)
test_conditions: Trained with perfect CSI on 10^6 instances (separate DNN per M and rho); tested on 10^5 independent same-generator instances, plus CSI-error and SNR sweeps (pp. 7-10)
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE precoder and iterative WMMSE (communication sum-rate benchmarks only); no earlier learned ISAC precoder compared; quantized/pruned versions are variants of the proposed DNN (p. 8)
metrics: Communication sum rate (bits/s/Hz), sum CRLB of target angles (dB), beampatterns, relative DNN complexity (percent of bits stored and computed), robustness to CSI error (pp. 8-10)
complexity: Relative only: 6-bit weights, 10% pruning need 16.88% of full-DNN bits for 96.1% of its sum rate; no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime (p. 9, Table 3)
openness: none (data generated in own Python/PyTorch simulation; no code or data link)
q1_support: p. 4: "which pertains to a Rayleigh channel model" - custom Rician/Rayleigh simulation (Rician on p. 3); only the path-loss parameters come from cited urban macrocell measurements [45]; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured dataset is used.
q2_support: p. 7: "in the same way to test the proposed precoder performance" - the test set is independent but from the same generator; the imperfect-CSI and SNR evaluations are sweeps, and p. 7: "generated for M = 10 and M = 20 antennas" means separate datasets and DNNs per antenna count.
q3_support: p. 8: "MMSE precoder and the iterative WMMSE precoder are" used as the sum-rate benchmarks; both are non-learned, and no earlier learned ISAC precoder is compared (DNN-size and quantization/pruning cases are variants of the proposed DNN).
q4_support: p. 9: "be stored and computed is only 19.68% of the full model" - Table 3 lists complexity (relatively) per quantization/pruning setting; relative percentages only, no absolute FLOPs, parameter count or runtime.
q5_support: p. 7: "The channel dataset is generated for" 10^6 instances by the authors' own simulation; no code or data link, no public channel dataset, and no availability statement appears in the paper.
notes: Included, area 5: unsupervised DNN designs the ISAC precoder (beams serving sensing and communication). Tables 1-3 were read from page images (pp. 8-9). q4 is marked 1 only because Table 3 and p. 9 quantify complexity as the percent of bits stored and computed relative to the full DNN; there is no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime, so the reviewer should confirm. q1 is 0: path-loss parameters are taken from published measurements [45] (not 3GPP), but the channel is a custom simulation.
